mechanism: Deterministic release archive construction followed by a bounded environment-variance replay matrix. Archive creation must consume only canonical payload bytes, canonical paths, explicit archive policy and source-derived timestamp; no ambient filesystem metadata may silently affect bytes.

exact_f2_mapping.proposed_next_generation_surface: src/frankenstein2/release_integrity.py or a narrowly imported src/frankenstein2/release_archive.py
exact_f2_mapping.downstream_gate: exact release-candidate ZIP builder -> pre-handoff archive receipt -> clean-machine testing

build_candidate.name: DETERMINISTIC_RELEASE_ZIP_AND_VARIANCE_FALSIFIER/v1
archive_rules: walk only canonical regular payload files; reject symlinks and noncanonical paths using the existing WP1107 path fence
write ZIP members in canonical POSIX path order; do not emit ambient directory entries
set every ZipInfo.date_time from one source-bound SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH-equivalent value, clamped to ZIP's representable range
set create_system and external attributes explicitly rather than inheriting host defaults
define deterministic file mode policy; executable semantics must be explicit and bound, never inherited from umask
clear comments and extra fields unless an explicitly versioned policy requires them
prefer ZIP_STORED for the first acceptance generation to eliminate compressor/version nondeterminism; compression may be added later only with toolchain identity and reproducibility evidence
write the canonical WP1107 manifest into the archive and bind archive_sha256 + manifest_sha256 + source_commit + source_tree + build_id + archive_policy_id in a pre-handoff receipt
build_candidate.acceptance_rule: For the same source_commit/source_tree/build_id/payload bytes/archive policy, every bounded variance case must yield the same full archive SHA-256. Any mismatch is a release-integrity failure with the responsible variance dimension reported.
negative_controls: mutating one payload byte must change manifest and archive identity
changing explicit archive policy must change policy identity and therefore release receipt identity
unbound executable-bit differences must fail closed rather than silently enter the archive
unexpected extra ZIP member must fail post-build verification

expected_benefit: Closes the gap between payload-level integrity and the actual handed-off ZIP bytes, exposes hidden environmental inputs before clean-machine/VPS work, and makes release replay independently hash-comparable.
failure_modes: ZIP DOS timestamps have a 1980 lower bound and two-second granularity; timestamp normalization must be explicit.
If compressed members are introduced, compressor/library-version changes can break byte reproducibility even with identical payloads.
Blindly forcing every file to mode 0644 can break executable entrypoints; mode semantics require an explicit policy.
Testing too many reprotest dimensions would waste CI/runtime budget; only dimensions that can reach archive bytes belong in the first matrix.
Byte-identical ZIP does not prove installation or runtime correctness.
counterhypothesis: WP1107's existing canonical manifest is sufficient because it already binds every payload file byte; archive byte reproducibility is unnecessary packaging aesthetics.
falsifier: Construct two ZIP containers from the same WP1107-equivalent payload and manifest while varying only ambient file mtimes/metadata. If archive hashes differ while extracted payload hashes and manifest remain identical, the current manifest gate does not bind the actual handed-off container bytes and the new property is distinct.
next_exact_action: Claim E3 and run a tiny local research-only ZIP fixture demonstrating whether identical payload/manifest bytes can produce different container hashes under ambient metadata, then if reproduced hand the deterministic builder specification to Trigger 4 as the next WP1107 generation.
